segment.source: Simulate evolution with agents that search for food, reproduce and pass on mutating genes. Inspect individual agents and analyze population and gene distribution in charts.
segment.target: Issimula l-evoluzzjoni b’aġenti li jfittxu l-ikel, jirriproduċu ruħhom u jgħaddu ġeni mutati. Eżamina aġenti individwali u analizza l-popolazzjoni u d-distribuzzjoni tal-ġeni fil-graffs.
